set.body: Rewrite the public novelty account as a staged claim ledger. Lead with the 2x2 closure map, then the evidence-pairing formula; describe the calculus as the scientific layer and contracts as the proof mechanism; keep fixed-linear RSA containment to one licensing paragraph; credit rsatoolbox and neighboring decomposition/connectivity literature; state Gamma as estimand identity rather than a discovery about generalization; scope coherent/configuration, rectangular, conservation, query-first, and coupling claims to current evidence; repair stale contract language. Acceptance: novelty.md, README, DESCRIPTION if needed, and evidence-pairing-contract.md agree; no first-to-market or strict-containment claim outruns a gate; links resolve in pkgdown.
set.title: Calibrate novelty.md and public architecture wording
